name: the New Project form

test_cases.action: tap "+" to open New Project, then tap the "Investing" chip (candidate t64)
test_cases.expected_result: the user either stays on the same form with its title, or moves elsewhere
test_cases.confirms_if: the user stays on the same form and the title is lost (promote)
test_cases.overturns_if: the title stays, or the user moved elsewhere (do not promote)
test_cases.observed_result: the chip filled the name field with "Investing"; the user stayed on the same form and "New Project" stayed in the top bar. Left without creating a project

deciding_evidence: plain title; chip taps leave it in place (spot-checked on the device).
